youtube.title: Why Propellers Look Bent on Camera 📱 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Film a spinning propeller with a phone and the blades look curved like rubber. The cause is the rolling shutter: a phone camera sensor reads the picture line by line from top to bottom, not all at once. Each line catches the fast-moving blade at a slightly different moment, so the rigid blade appears warped.
